::: {#fig-lagrange-line-3d fig-alt="Surface plot of x1 squared plus x2 squared over x1 and x2 from -1.6 to 2, a bowl opening upward with its lowest point at the origin.
A blue curve on the bowl lies above the straight line 3 x1 plus 4 x2 equals 5, running from upper left to lower right.
Its lowest point, above (0.6, 0.8) at height 1, is marked by a vermilion circle.
That height is the smallest value of x1 squared plus x2 squared on the line."}

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

### R

```{r}
#| label: lagrange-line-3d-r
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
ll3_x1_3d <- seq(-1.6, 2, length.out = 101)
ll3_x2_3d <- seq(-1.6, 2, length.out = 101)
ll3_f_3d <- function(x1, x2) x1^2 + x2^2
ll3_z_3d <- outer(ll3_x2_3d, ll3_x1_3d, ll3_f_3d)
ll3_line_x1_3d <- seq(-0.5, 2, length.out = 101)
ll3_line_x2_3d <- (5 - 3 * ll3_line_x1_3d) / 4
ll3_line_z_3d <- ll3_f_3d(ll3_line_x1_3d, ll3_line_x2_3d)
ll3_line_3d <- tibble::tibble(
  x1 = ll3_line_x1_3d,
  x2 = ll3_line_x2_3d,
  z = ll3_line_z_3d
)
ll3_point_3d <- tibble::tibble(x1 = 0.6, x2 = 0.8, z = 1)
ll3_line_style_3d <- list(color = "#0072B2", width = 5)
ll3_mark_3d <- list(color = "#D55E00", size = 6, symbol = "circle")
plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = ll3_x1_3d,
    y = ll3_x2_3d,
    z = ll3_z_3d,
    colorscale = list(c(0, 1), c("#E5E5E5", "#808080")),
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.7
  ) |>
  plotly::add_trace(
    data = ll3_line_3d,
    x = ~x1,
    y = ~x2,
    z = ~z,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = ll3_line_style_3d,
    name = "constraint"
  ) |>
  plotly::add_markers(
    data = ll3_point_3d,
    x = ~x1,
    y = ~x2,
    z = ~z,
    marker = ll3_mark_3d,
    name = "minimizer"
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "x1"),
      yaxis = list(title = "x2"),
      zaxis = list(title = "f(x)"),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9))
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h")
  )
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: lagrange-line-3d-python
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of x1 squared plus x2 squared over x1 and x2 from -1.6 to
#|   2, a bowl opening upward with its lowest point at the origin. A blue
#|   curve on the bowl lies above the straight line 3 x1 plus 4 x2 equals 5,
#|   running from upper left to lower right. Its lowest point, above (0.6,
#|   0.8) at height 1, is marked by a vermilion circle. That height is the
#|   smallest value of x1 squared plus x2 squared on the line.
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-width: 6
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

ll_x1_3d, ll_x2_3d = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-1.6, 2, 101),
                                 np.linspace(-1.6, 2, 101))
ll_line_x1_3d = np.linspace(-0.5, 2, 101)
ll_line_x2_3d = (5 - 3 * ll_line_x1_3d) / 4
ll_line_z_3d = ll_line_x1_3d**2 + ll_line_x2_3d**2
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4.5))
ax = fig.add_subplot(projection="3d")
ax.plot_surface(ll_x1_3d, ll_x2_3d, ll_x1_3d**2 + ll_x2_3d**2,
                color="grey", alpha=0.4)
ax.plot(ll_line_x1_3d, ll_line_x2_3d, ll_line_z_3d, color="#0072B2",
        label="constraint")
ax.scatter([0.6], [0.8], [1], marker="o", color="#D55E00", s=50,
           label="minimizer")
ax.set_xlabel("x1")
ax.set_ylabel("x2")
ax.set_zlabel("f(x)")
ax.legend(loc="upper right")
plt.show();
```

:::

The [graph](functions.qmd#def-graph) of the [objective](#def-objective-function) $x_1^2 + x_2^2$,
the surface whose [level curves](vector-calculus.qmd#def-level-curve) (circles) are in @fig-lagrange-line,
with the constraint line $3 x_1 + 4 x_2 = 5$ lifted onto it.
Along the constraint the objective is lowest above the [minimizer](#def-minimizer-over-feasible-set) $\tp{(0.6, 0.8)}$ (@exm-qp-equality), where the line touches the circle $c = 1$.

:::
